story: Microsoft 365 receives the domain's mail and has a DKIM key in place to sign it. Twelve other services are set up to send as the domain: six transactional (Amazon SES, Mailgun, Mailjet, Postmark, SendGrid, SparkPost), two support and CRM (Freshdesk, Zendesk), one mailbox (Google Workspace), two marketing (Iterable, Mailchimp), one commerce and apps (Shopify); two more are likely from a DKIM key name alone (Customer.io, Mandrill). Not checked: the website (turned off), DKIM selectors past the first 27 on three subdomains, six subdomains whose DNS failed to answer, 34 names from certificate logs left out by a limit, and the crt.sh certificate log (read only with --ct).
